# CityWorld Neo intercity bridge runtime fixture

The AngelScript diagnostic in this directory is original project work and is
licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

The fixture contains no CityWorld geometry, textures, placements, or archive
payloads. At runtime it observes the caller-supplied, authenticated
`CityWorld.zip` and the locally generated `CityWorldNextLocalOverlay.zip`.
Those private packages must remain separate and are not redistributable through
this repository or the diagnostic artifacts.
